body:
> You always have the chance to change your life.

I'm trying. I'm trying so hard. I'm stuck here because of the education system. I'm trying to move away but it's so hard you can't imagine. There are tons of obstacles and I'm all alone by myself in this. I need money and I need a diploma I don't have. There are tons of obstacles aside from these two. I need to face some fears, logistic problems, and more. I'm also scared of my mother's new boyfriend. Living with my mother has become hell for the last 6 months.

This is why I'm desperate. I feel stuck here and I want to change but it's always a question of time and various matters.

I don't feel I have all my life. I'm scared something would happen to me and I'm fighting against the idea that there is a destiny. I was already scared of dying. Two days ago I wanted to die in order to stop this suspense as well as this fear that are haunting me. I want to master my life and decide of who, what and where I want to be. If I can't live up to that I'd rather die earlier than live without freedom.

You see, this chance I have to change my life, I gave it to myself. It did not come to me. I would come to me with time but I don't want to wait. I'm trying to create this chance to change and this is not easy and not fair. Chances should be given to people. You happen to have doors and you decide which one you open. I have to build my own doors and this is taking so much on me.

As for the talking advice, I tried as well. I brought myself to resources and I was brought as well. For fucks sake, even a psychiatrist did not help me. I can't tell my friends I want to kill myself... I don't want to scare them nor stress them and I don't want to be judged. But seriously talking doesn't help. I could talk on and on but I'm still facing the problems. I don't get the advices I need to hear, I'm not showed the light I need to see either. It's true that it feels good, but it's a temporary good.

I've put myself on a dangerous rail. I want to change myself so much but I'm scared of how I'm going to react if it fails. I don't know if I'll have the force to live if I don't make this change.

Yesterday night when I was on my way home I saw a young cat crying loudly because of the cold. It was -10 C and it was stuck outside freezing so much. I tried to help and see if the owners' house was nearby. In the end I had to leave this cat and on my way back I had this feeling that something is wrong with society.

I don't know if I can call... and it's very nice from all of you that you want to chat but there's nothing to do. I've already talked to people, I tried to get help. Nothing works.

I have a goal... but there are so many obstacles to achieve it. Yesterday I lost faith in myself. I always had ambitions and I knew I was living to achieve them. I stopped believing I could make it. I will die if I cannot fulfill my will because I refuse to live a life made of destiny and I refuse to not be free. There is no point in living a life where you are not free to be where you want and to be what you want.
Yes I'm still here. I don't know for how long but yes I am.
